params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $roots=Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE -Directory -Depth 4 | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName '.git') }; foreach($r in $roots){ $url=(git -C $r.FullName remote get-url origin 2>$null); if($url -match 'fengie/mhw-mods'){ Write-Output ('REPO='+$r.FullName); Write-Output ('BRANCH='+(git -C $r.FullName branch --show-current)); Write-Output ('HEAD='+(git -C $r.FullName rev-parse HEAD)); Write-Output 'STATUS:'; git -C $r.FullName status --short; Write-Output '---' } }
